issue.title: Fix parallel-suite flakes in stall watchdog and slow-tools snapshot
issue.description: Discovered during just check after splitting src/sase/bead/project.py. The 28-worker fast suite failed tests/ace/tui/util/test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent and tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots. The watchdog passed immediately in an isolated pytest rerun; the snapshot passed immediately through its proper just test-visual lane with 26 workers. Investigate shared timing/render contention so the default parallel suite is reliable.

payload.entry: Closed during open task-bead audit on master d462e97bb. The exact watchdog node tests/ace/tui/util/test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent passed 3 consecutive focused runs. just test-visual passed 393 tests with 1 skipped, including tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots, and the standard just test lane did not fail either named node.

payload.close_reason: no longer reproducible on current master

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during the unrelated timezone-display test-file split on 2026-08-03: full just check failed test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent under 23-worker suite load; the exact node passed immediately afterward in isolation in 0.18s. This is the exact watchdog flake previously closed as no longer reproducible.

Relayed by epic land agent sase-f2.land from phase worker sase-f2.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, 2026-08-03T19:13:15Z), an independent reporter from the existing creator and the toobig-1i +1. During epic sase-f2's prompt-archive phase, the required full 'just check' failed one stall-watchdog test under parallel suite load and that test passed on a direct isolated rerun — the same fail-under-load / pass-in-isolation signature this bead tracks. sase-f2.2 recorded the symptom without naming the node, so I cannot confirm it was test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent specifically; treating it as the same watchdog contention defect. Impact: this flake keeps intercepting the mandatory just check gate for agents whose changes are entirely unrelated to the TUI, forcing each of them to re-run and hand-adjudicate the failure. The other half of sase-f2.2's report, ACE Config Center PNG snapshot drift, is NOT part of this bead and no longer reproduces: just test-visual on master 15e4213cc passed 407 tests with 1 skipped.

Independent recurrence while repairing default-branch CI at 519cd73f2 on 2026-08-03: mandatory just check passed formatting, all lint suites, SASE validation, and plan validation, then its 28-worker fast suite failed only tests/ace/tui/util/test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent after 25,776 passes and 7 skips. The exact node passed immediately afterward with SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 in 0.18s. The CI-repair changes touch only chop-runner test timestamps, metadata-search settling, and prompt visual settling, so this independently confirms the existing contention-only watchdog flake and its impact on the required gate.
